en: An old, tinted postcard showing the ruins of a rounded Romanesque structure set in a wooded park. The central ruin has tall, narrow arched windows and a large semicircular apse. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit in the foreground. The image is framed by trees and surrounded by a light vignette. At the bottom, red printed captions identify the location as Nijmegen and the ruin as Valkhof.
